control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unrelieved potential energy found after isolation of TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-3002 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 31 August 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
